tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List every business location this ReputeMap org manages, with ids to use in the other tools.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: List Google reviews for the org (newest first) with the published reply text inlined. Filter by location, star-rating range, replied/unreplied, or a trailing day window.

tools.name: get_review_stats
tools.description: Review stats per location and org totals: review counts, average rating, 1-5 star breakdown, unanswered count, and activity in the trailing window (default 30 days).

tools.name: send_review_request
tools.description: Send ONE review-request email to a real customer, through ReputeMap's campaign engine (respects unsubscribes and the suppression list; idempotent per campaign). This emails a real person - only use it when the user explicitly asks to request a review.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current month's API credit usage for this org (shared between the REST API and MCP tools).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_reviews, get_review_stats, send_review_request · Public sink: send_review_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_reviews, get_review_stats, send_review_request · Public sink: send_review_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
